data.title: US sailors warmly welcomed in Pattaya
data.description: More than 5,000 US Navy personnel from the USS Abraham Lincoln have begun making their way into Pattaya, where they are expected to pour about 100 million baht into the local economy during five days of long-overdue shore leave.

data.title: Cabinet changes location of Korat floral expo
data.description: The cabinet has agreed to change the venue for an international floral exhibition in Nakhon Ratchasima, a decision that has shocked and angered residents.

data.title: Bus crash in Egypt’s Sinai region kills 22
data.description: CAIRO - A passenger bus overturned on a desert highway in Egypt’s eastern Sinai Peninsula on Wednesday, killing 22 people and injuring 28 others, authorities said.

data.title: New York City to ban AI in schools through Grade 8
data.description: NEW YORK - New York City will ban the use of artificial intelligence (AI) for students in public schools through eighth grade, a source close to the matter told Agence France-Presse (AFP) on Wednesday, confirming US media reports.

data.title: 10 missing as Turkish cargo ship sinks after collision
data.description: ISTANBUL - A Turkish cargo ship sank in the Marmara Sea near Istanbul after colliding with a second vessel, with rescuers searching for its 10 crew members, Turkish officials said Wednesday.

data.title: Gary Glitter pleads not guilty to UK child sex offences
data.description: LONDON - ⁠Former ⁠British pop ​star Paul Gadd, better known ​by his ‌stage name Gary Glitter, pleaded not guilty in a London court on Wednesday to eight ​charges ⁠of historic sex offences against a young girl.

data.title: Ebola death toll passes 3,000 in DR Congo
data.description: KINSHASA - The deadliest ever Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has now claimed the lives of more than 3,000 people, according to the latest official figures released on Wednesday.

data.title: Accused agent for corporate ‘mule accounts’ arrested
data.description: A woman accused of acting as an agent for a major corporate mule-account network, backed by a Chinese financier, has been arrested in Bangkok. Police say accounts supplied by the network had been linked to more than 27 fraud cases.

data.title: Who Holds the Brakes? Building Trust in Thailand’s AI Economy
data.description: Sigve Brekke, Group CEO of True Corporation Plc. , shared his perspectives in a keynote titled “From Algorithmic Shock to Ethical Shift: Why Trust Is the Currency of Thailand’s Digital Future” at GCNT EXPO 2026, held under the theme “FROM SHOCK TO SHIFT – Sustainable Transition in a Fractured World”. The event was organized by the Global Compact Network Thailand (GCNT) at True Digital Park.

data.title: Wildfire haze forces 1.4 million Indonesian students into remote learning
data.description: JAKARTA - Around ⁠1.4 million ⁠students in six Indonesian provinces ​have shifted to online learning due to poor air quality triggered ​by forest and land fires, ‌an official said on Wednesday.

data.title: Teen gunman held at Kamphaeng Phet school
data.description: Police detained a 14-year-old boy on Wednesday after he entered a secondary school in Kamphaeng Phet and fired a pistol. No injuries were reported.

data.title: LG launches Life’s Good campaign to help people focus on what matters
data.description: LG Electronics (LG)launchedits 2026 Life's Good campaignunder the key message"Free up your mind."The campaignexplores howLG AI can helpreducethe mental load of everyday lifebyquietlytaking care of routinedemand s, creating more room for people tofocus on whattruly matters.

data.title: Bangkok halts new data centre approvals
data.description: No more licences will be issued for new data centres in Bangkok, governor Chadchart Sittipunt said on Wednesday, responding to growing concerns about potential negative impacts associated with the facilities.

data.title: Iran attacks US sites after American strikes, wedding deaths
data.description: TEHRAN — Iran launched a wave of attacks on US sites across the Middle East on Wednesday as violence surged after an extensive American bombardment and the deaths of four people at an Iranian wedding party.

data.title: EU eyes Russia sanctions after drone ‘attack’ in Germany
data.description: WICKLOW, Ireland - The European Union (EU) on Wednesday said it had summoned Russia’s top diplomat as it eyed sanctions after a drone incident in Germany that the bloc’s foreign policy chief said bore the marks of “state-sponsored terrorism”.

data.title: Global temperature rise to top 1.5C in few years, bringing disasters
data.description: The global temperature is set to rise 1.5 degrees ​Celsius above pre-industrial levels within the next few years, intensifying the risks of disasters and health hazards, a report by the UN Environment Programme showed on Wednesday.

data.title: Toyota Supports Volunteer Mission for Royal Funeral Preparation
data.description: On August 27, 2026, Mr. Suraphoom Udomwong, Executive Vice President of Toyota Motor Thailand Co., Ltd., handed over 9 Toyota vehicles along with drivers to the Office of the Permanent Secretary, Prime Minister's Office, represented by Mrs. Chuenchiwan Limteerakul, Deputy Permanent Secretary, Prime Minister's Office. This support aims to facilitate transportation for volunteers and officials performing duties in preparing and organizing the Royal Funeral Ceremony for Her Royal Highness Princess Bajrakitiyabha Narendiradevyavati Krom Luang Ratchasarinee Siripatchar Maha Wanrajarat Chida.

data.title: Gourmet Eats elevates mooncake gifting with “Gourmet Mooncake Festival 2026”
data.description: Bringing together over 50 leading hotel and restaurant brands, the festival taps into growing demand for premium seasonal gifts driven by craftsmanship,storytellingand design.

data.title: Nepal tunnel rescuers seek trapped workers but hit dead ends
data.description: KATHMANDU - Nepali rescuers searched on Wednesday for survivors feared trapped inside hydropower tunnels a week after devastating floods, but hopes were fading as teams hit dead ends and no one was confirmed alive.

data.title: Southeast Asia’s scam gangs regroup after Cambodia’s purge
data.description: Cambodia says it has flushed out a scam industry estimated to have stolen tens of billions of US dollars last year alone, but a string of arrests in recent days suggests the gangs behind it may have simply changed address.

data.title: Venice to roll out red carpet for Clooney
data.description: VENICE - The Venice Film Festival kicks off on the sun-splashed Lido with a bang on Wednesday, with the glamorous cinema showcase handing George Clooney a lifetime achievement award on its opening night.

data.title: Common causes of Bangkok fire and how to prevent them
data.description: According to the Bangkok Fire and Rescue Department, electrical faults were the leading cause of the 1,745 fires recorded in Bangkok between 2023 and 2025, accounting for 823 cases in total.

data.title: Passenger voices fear over 'ghost mask’ inside ride-hail car
data.description: A ride-hail passenger took to social media to raise concerns over safety after an unsettling experience in which they found a frightening human-like mask inside the vehicle.

data.title: ONE Championship: Jonathan Haggerty predicts Hiroki Akimoto fight ‘won’t go past two rounds’
data.description: Jonathan Haggerty has predicted his ONE Championship bantamweight kickboxing title defence against Hiroki Akimoto will not make it past the second round.

data.title: Museum Siam explores Thai identity through foreign eyes
data.description: Museum Siam’s foreign-perspective show runs to October 4, alongside 14 interactive rooms, century-old architecture and exhibition-inspired laksa.

data.title: JSCCIB Chairman Sees Low-Carbon Transition as Major Growth Opportunity for Thailand
data.description: The Co-Chairman of the Joint Standing Committee on Commerce, Industry and Banking (JSCCIB) highlighted the low-carbon transition as both an investment opportunity and a new source of national competitiveness. He called for accelerating the “Reinvent Thailand” agenda to connect the public sector, private sector, and financial institutions, turning policy into execution while bringing SMEs into the low-carbon value chain. He also emphasised the role of Bangkok Business Summit 2026 as a platform to showcase Thailand’s economic potential ahead of the IMF–World Bank Group Annual Meetings and its ASEAN leadership in 2028.

data.title: Emily’s Introduces "Konjac Chicken Noodles", a Healthier Take on Its Signature Dish
data.description: Who says healthy food has to be boring? Emily’s, the popular comfort-food brand known for its signature shredded chicken noodles, founded by Naiyanachanok Patamasingh Na Ayutthaya and Thaparat Waerojruedee, is introducing a new menu item: “Konjac Chicken Noodles”, a healthier twist on its best-selling dish as a  Limited-Edition menu, Konjac Chicken Noodles will be served only until the end of October.

data.title: 9 Temples to Heaven selected to represent Thailand at the 99th Oscars
data.description: Following award wins in Shanghai and New Zealand, Sompot Chidgasornpongse’s family drama will open the Bangkok International Film Festival before its nationwide release.

data.title: Amid war, Ukrainian soldiers celebrate love at ritual wedding
data.description: UKRAINE - As twilight settled on a hillside by a river near the eastern Ukrainian front, two soldiers exchanged wedding vows during a Slavic ritual honouring ancestors and fallen warriors.
